_comment: Single source of truth for modes. Read by main (prompt building, native mode menu) and the renderer (labels, dropdown). kind: template = PROMPT_TEMPLATE filled with promptName + instruction; standalone = main/prompts/<key>.txt; builder = handled by a renderer builder flow, transcript passed through unchanged. profile: voice = uses the user's "How you write" notes; about = uses their "About you" notes.

modes.label: Balanced
modes.desc: Role · Task · Context · Output — works for anything
modes.instruction: Create a well-rounded prompt with appropriate detail for general use.

modes.label: Detailed
modes.desc: More depth, more constraints — for complex requests
modes.instruction: Create a thorough, comprehensive prompt with extensive context, edge cases, and detailed constraints.

modes.label: Concise
modes.desc: Tight, focused prompt — forces sharp thinking
modes.instruction: Create the shortest possible effective prompt — include only what is essential for Claude to succeed.

modes.label: Chain
modes.desc: Step-by-step reasoning — best for complex analysis
modes.instruction: Structure the prompt to require Claude to reason step-by-step before answering. Include a Steps section with numbered reasoning stages.

modes.label: Code
modes.desc: Stack · constraints · output format — production quality
modes.instruction: Optimise this prompt for code generation. Always include Tech stack and Data model sections. Be precise about interfaces, data shapes, and output format.

modes.label: Design
modes.desc: UI · UX · component thinking — frames design problems

modes.label: Refine
modes.desc: Describe what's wrong with a design — get a precise change request

modes.label: Polish
modes.desc: Paste rough text, speak the change — get it back clean

modes.label: Video
modes.desc: Veo · Sora · Runway · Kling · Pika — model-aware params

modes.label: Email
modes.desc: Speak the situation → ready-to-send email with tone
